authority_limit: Provenance does not by itself establish truth, integrity, correctness, causal sufficiency, conformance or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Entities, activities, agents and qualified derivation/attribution/association relations can record provenance of evidence artifacts.
title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

authority_limit: SLSA evidence does not prove source correctness, semantic fitness, runtime safety, provider quality or production acceptance.
bounded_implication: Provenance and verification bind scoped supply-chain claims to subjects, builders, build definitions, materials and threat-model levels.
title: SLSA Specification v1.2

authority_limit: Statement integrity does not prove predicate truth, issuer authority, completeness, current applicability or relying-party acceptance.
bounded_implication: Statements bind identified subjects to typed predicates and predicate schemas, enabling signed, policy-appraised attestations.
title: in-toto Attestation Framework

authority_limit: A verifier result is not a universal trust verdict, application authorization, correctness proof or relying-party acceptance.
bounded_implication: Evidence, endorsements, reference values, appraisal policy, attestation results and relying-party decisions are distinct artifacts and stages.
title: RFC 9334: RATS Architecture

authority_limit: SSDF practice evidence does not certify absence of vulnerabilities, semantic correctness, operational fitness or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Secure-development practices require defined review, analysis, testing, provenance and vulnerability-response evidence rather than product labels.
title: NIST SP 800-218: Secure Software Development Framework

authority_limit: A fuzzing campaign is bounded by target, instrumentation, corpus, generator, runtime, sanitizers, duration and oracle; no crash is not proof of correctness.
bounded_implication: Coverage-guided fuzzing executes a target over generated/mutated corpus inputs and retains coverage-increasing or crashing cases.
title: libFuzzer Documentation

authority_limit: Model checking establishes properties of the modeled specification within tool/bound assumptions, not refinement to implementation or unmodeled environment behavior.
bounded_implication: A formal specification can be checked for stated properties over explored models and bounds, producing counterexample behaviors when violated.
title: Specifying Systems / TLC Model Checker

authority_limit: Passing the suite proves only encoded cases and declared dialect support, not universal semantic correctness, security or application fitness.
bounded_implication: Editioned conformance cases can exercise specified JSON Schema behavior across independent implementations.
title: JSON Schema Test Suite

authority_limit: Telemetry is runtime observation; missing signals are not absence of failure, and signal integrity does not establish business truth, completeness or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Traces, metrics, logs and profiles are distinct scoped telemetry signals with instrumentation and resource context.
title: OpenTelemetry Specification

authority_limit: Measurement uncertainty guidance does not select domain acceptance thresholds, prove model validity or remove sampling/systematic error.
bounded_implication: Measurement results and uncertainty statements require declared measurand, components, coverage and reporting method.
title: NIST Technical Note 1297

authority_limit: Cryptographic verification is not claim truth, issuer authority for every use, subject identity, conformance or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Claims, issuer, subject, evidence, securing mechanism, status and verifier decisions occupy separate positions in a credential ecosystem.
title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0

authority_limit: Content provenance and signature validation do not establish factual truth, completeness, authorship intent, safety or fitness for a relying decision.
bounded_implication: Signed manifests can record assertions, ingredients and provenance for digital content with explicit trust and validation processing.
publisher: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
title: C2PA Technical Specification
